sentences.japanese: ナプキンで唇をきれいにしなさい。
sentences.english: Clean your lips with the napkin.

sentences.japanese: ゴリラは話すのに唇や舌を使うことができないが、別の方法で人々とコミュニケーションができるのである。
sentences.english: Gorillas cannot use their lips and tongues to speak, but they can communicate with people in other ways.

sentences.japanese: 母は赤ん坊の唇にキスをした。
sentences.english: The mother kissed her baby on the lips.

sentences.japanese: 病人は唇をかすかに動かした。
sentences.english: The patient moved his lips slightly.

sentences.japanese: 彼女は固く唇を閉じて決して泣くまいと決意した。
sentences.english: She pressed her lips together and willed herself not to cry.
